content:
maya (PM): I want to pilot a 3-week design-partner run focused on launch readiness for the new routing + KV-cache flow. Aim: recruit 6 partners (4 hosted, 1 dedicated, 1 private), collect 25 canonical prompts, 3 failing reproductions per partner, and produce a prioritized fix list with owners. Thoughts on cadence/incentives? :thought_balloon:

jordan (Eng): +1. recommend we treat week1 as intake/telemetry only, week2 for triage + small mitigations (<5 dev-days), week3 for final decisions and rollouts. small mitigations need rollback plan.

priya (CS): recruitment note: target partners with real-time chat and batch embedding use-cases. Incentive: $2k platform credit + priority access to the next private image model. Ask for at least one engineering contact + one PM from partner.

anika (Research): for prioritization, propose a weighted score: (Severity*0.5) + (Frequency*0.3) + (StrategicValue*0.2). Severity and Frequency on 1-5. StrategicValue = 0/1/2. We'll capture short user stories for context.

maya (PM): good — keep scoring light. define "failing reproduction" as a reproducible prompt + steps that produce wrong/slow/error behavior on our standard test harness or partner environment. capture logs + minimal repro.

jordan (Eng): telemetry for dedicated/private: we can provide a tiny agent that hashes prompts locally and emits counts only (no raw text). requires partner opt-in and a one-line install. sample install snippet:```bash
# r-infer telemetry agent (install)
pip install r-infer-telemetry
export R_INFER_OPTIN=true
python -m r_infer_telemetry --collect
```

priya (CS): recruitment timeline: outreach this week, confirm commits next week, onboarding one-off 30m calls. we should include an "exit-form" they fill at week3 for retrospective.

anika (Research): data capture checklist: canonical prompts (25), per-partner failing cases (min 3), weekly 5-question pulse (1-10), screen recordings for UX flows when applicable, and anonymized telemetry. I'll provide Google Sheet template and scoring tab.

maya (PM): shipping criteria proposal: an item is a "launch-blocker" if Severity>=4 AND (Frequency>=3 OR security/regulatory). Anything scoring >=8 by weighted formula becomes a "high-priority" post-launch item.

jordan (Eng): add operational acceptance: any mitigation we ship must include automated smoke tests + documented rollback steps in the runbook. ops-team will review before deploy.

priya (CS): partner-facing opt-in wording suggestion: "Join our DP sprint — opt-in to share anonymized metrics (latency, error codes, prompt-hash counts) to help us prioritize fixes. No raw prompt text will be stored." keep it short.

maya (PM): logistics owner list: outreach & intake = priya, onboarding kit & checklist = anika, telemetry shim = jordan, sprint epic + comms = maya, ops rollback doc = oncall.

anika (Research): recommend daily triage slack thread + Tue/Thu 30m syncs mid-sprint. also capture participant quotes for qualitative color.

jordan (Eng): ETA for shim + agent package ~4 business days. will open a draft repo and share link.

devops-bot: Reminder: create sprint epic and tag rotation. Use tag dp-sprint-6161.

maya (PM): ok I'll spin up the epic now and post the partner intake form link here when ready. tagging: @jordan (Eng) @anika (Research) @priya (CS) — please confirm EOW deliverables. :rocket:
